It deals devastating damage—even against Guardians.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Arrow |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Ancient Arrow}} Ancient Arrows are a special type of [[Arrow]] designed specifically for defeating [[Guardian]]s. They are daggers made from Ancient Technology that were repurposed as Arrows. [[Robbie]] created the Ancient Arrows about 40 or 50 years after the [[Great Calamity]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 385}} They belong to the [[Ancient Soldier Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all [[Weapon]]s created by Robbie.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} There are a total of nine [[Treasure Chest]]s containing Ancient Arrows, all found at [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]. Three of them contain one Ancient Arrow, five of them contain a bundle of 3 Ancient Arrows, and one contains a bundle of 5 Ancient Arrows.{{Cite|{{Big|Ancient Arrow x3}}
A bundle of three ancient arrows. Daggers created using ancient technology have been repurposed for use as arrows. Extremely effective against Guardians.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Ancient Arrow x5}}
A bundle of five ancient arrows. Daggers created using ancient technology have been repurposed for use as arrows. Extremely effective against Guardians.|Inventory|BotW}} [[Link]] can also create them in exchange for [[Ancient Material]]s, [[Arrow]]s, and [[Rupee]]s by using the [[Ancient Oven]], Cherry, at the Akkala Ancient Tech Lab. They can purchased individually, or in bundles of three or five. Link can also receive one from [[Beedle]] at any [[Stable]], during what he calls Customer Appreciation Day.{{Cite|Hey! You're a great customer, and since today is Customer Appreciation Day... I want you to have this!|Beedle|BotW}} It is triggered after Link frees his first [[Divine Beast]]. If Link is unable to carry more Ancient Arrows, Beedle will be unable to give him his reward.{{Cite|Oh, no... your {{Color BotW|Blue|inventory}} is full. It's a real shame, but I guess we'll have to give up on this for now...|Beedle|BotW}} Ancient Arrows deal moderate damage to [[Boss]]es, but heavy damage to Guardians. If an Ancient Arrow strikes a Guardian directly in the eye, the Guardian is instantly defeated. If used on enemies other than Guardians and [[Boss]]es, the Enemy and its [[Weapon]]s will completely disintegrate. Enemies that disintegrate due to the Ancient Arrow will also not drop any [[Material]]s. Ancient Arrows do not disappear after being shot at an object, allowing Link to retrieve them if he misses an Enemy. Ancient Arrows will penetrate and stick to certain objects, such as wood, and certain Materials, such as [[Hylian Shroom]]s. Ancient Arrows can cause ice blocks made from the [[Cryonis]] [[Rune]] to break, and will instantly blow up [[Remote Bomb]]s. Ancient Arrows can also be used to instantly dispatch [[Divine Beast Vah Medoh]]'s [[Cannon]]s. Ancient Arrows are one of the only means of defeating [[Dark Beast Ganon]], alongside the Light Arrows from the [[Bow of Light]] and [[Twilight Bow]] as well as [[Sword Beam]]s from the [[Master Sword]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{SSBU|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} An Ancient Arrow, alongside the [[Ancient Bow]], appears as [[Link]]'s [[Final Smash]] in {{SSBU}}.
